authority.freeze_order_law: gates and vocabulary freeze BEFORE any candidate PnL is computed

candidate_gates.cell_precondition: a cell is EVALUABLE iff arm C's frozen selection routes at least one non-FLAT specialist somewhere in the cell; a cell where every regime is thin (C degenerates to FLAT by floor law) is labeled NOT_RUN_THIN_REGIME, excluded from the overall denominator, and reported
candidate_gates.cost_tier_of_gates: gates G1-G6 compare at BASE tier 1.0x unless stated

gates.law: net_1.5x > 0 (not collapsing at the 1.5x stress tier)
net_1x > max(net_A1_1x, net_A2_1x) on that cell (beats the better always-on baseline)
net_1x > net_B_1x on that cell (beats the original V2 mapping reference, post engine-equivalence)
no single-fold dependency: (# outer folds with net_fold > 0) >= 3 OR (sum of the 4 fold nets - max fold net) > 0

not merely trading less: net_1x > net_D_1x AND, if F is valid on the cell, net_1x > median(F seed nets at 1.0x); if F is NOT_RUN_CONTROL_MATCHING, record F_INVALID_REST_ON_ABDE and the gate rests on the D comparison alone — the F failure is reported, never silent
reproduction: an independent re-run of the scored process produces byte-identical tier files for every arm x cell x tier
A7 terminal fresh-context clean: zero unresolved HIGH/CRITICAL findings

candidate_gates.overall_pass: ALL EVALUABLE cells pass per_cell_pass; cells excluded as NOT_RUN_THIN_REGIME are reported but do not block if at least one cell remains evaluable
candidate_gates.per_cell_pass: ALL of G1-G8 PASS on that cell (G8 is cycle-level: it passes for a cell iff the terminal A7 audit is clean)
candidate_gates.subject: arm C only, per cell, then overall

contamination_disclosure.ceiling_law: the strongest verdict any result of this cycle can earn is DISCOVERY_CANDIDATE_FOR_PROSPECTIVE_VALIDATION — even an all-gates-PASS outcome grants no more
contamination_disclosure.corpus_status: the WHOLE corpus is outcome-observed: every price, every cached V2 decision and every V2 outcome was observed before this cycle
contamination_disclosure.promotion_ban: no promotion to shadow, paper, live, or orders — ever, from this cycle; no live-ready or profitable language in any artifact
contamination_disclosure.successor_law: the only forward path is a NEW prospective-validation cycle on future/never-observed data or a genuinely never-observed time extension
contamination_disclosure.walk_forward_honesty: the nested walk-forward law reduces overfitting but does NOT convert observed history into untouched validation

honest_decision_table.pattern: all cells thin; C is FLAT everywhere by floor law
cost identity or D/E control authority broken, >=1 cell evaluable
all 8 gates PASS on all evaluable cells (F valid or F-invalid-with-D-only-fallback)
C positive at 1.0x but net <= 0 at 1.5x
C beats B but not the better always-on baseline
C profitable only via one fold
C beats A/B but not D or a valid F median
C passes economics but reproduction or A7 fails
any gates fail on any evaluable cell, nothing above fires

counting_laws: every computed outcome counts against the budget EVEN IF its artifact fails to publish — publication failure is not un-trialed
the denominator is fixed at 21 before the scored run; all 21 must reach a terminal state (scored, or explicitly NOT_RUN_* labeled, or hard-blocked) before any verdict
no mid-run stopping on interim numbers; the full denominator runs even if early cells look bad
arm F's 21 seeds are one scored arm instance per cell (median headline), not 21 trials
zero-cost variants are diagnostics inside the same trial and can never support a PASS
P1 attribution and P2 feasibility are diagnostic and consume no scored trials
trial_accounting.identity: 3 cells (BTC_H1, BTC_H4, SPY_D1) x 7 scored arm instances (A1, A2, B, C, D, E, F)

ladder.condition: any of: REGIME_TIMELINE_MISMATCH on any cell; B engine-equivalence gate failure; fold reconciliation identity failure; no-lookahead or turnover-law violation counter > 0 anywhere; reproduction byte-mismatch persisting after one full re-run; execution/infrastructure failure preventing the scored run
no TECHABORT and ZERO evaluable cells (every cell's selectable regimes below the outer sample floors => C routed FLAT everywhere for sample reasons)

at least one evaluable cell, but evaluation authority is broken: the frozen cost contract fails digest verification OR per-fill costs on the B replay do not reproduce to <1e-6 from the frozen contract (cost authority), OR arm D or E cannot be executed as frozen on some evaluable cell (control authority)
candidate_gates.overall_pass is true (all G1-G8 on all evaluable cells)
anything else: the run completed with >=1 evaluable cell and arm C failed at least one gate on at least one evaluable cell

verdict_ladder.law: evaluate top to bottom; the FIRST matching condition is the cycle verdict; the ladder is total — every terminal state of the cycle maps to exactly one verdict

verdict_vocabulary.law: the cycle verdict is EXACTLY one of these strings; no other verdict string may appear in any cycle artifact; misspellings are hard failures
